title: SmootherFont
description: SmootherFont is texture pack which change your font
body:
Simple texturepack which change font texture.
With this texturepack font is more square shaped and thinner.
That txt is good for PVP (**in my opinion**).

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



SUPPORTED LETTERS: a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p r s t u v w x y z ą ć ę ł ń ó ś ź ż ( there is only letters in  this list so there isn't punctuation marks! )


</details>


(The font will belong to the future texture pack!)
